reason: Critical functionality is missing (no run loop, no interactions, no metrics), so the simulation does not execute. With one iteration remaining, a focused pass can implement a minimal but complete daily simulation loop, parameter mapping, core interactions, and required metrics to reach a runnable, spec-compliant MVP.

specific_areas: Implement Simulation.run/simulate daily loop over time_steps

Map all spec parameters to logic (peer_influence_weight, risk_perception_weight, policy_effect_weight, info_campaign_effect, visibility_weight_at_locations, habit_persistence, abandonment_rate, trust_decay, campaign_frequency_days, observation_noise, enforcement_level)
Execute required daily interactions: peer influence, household norms, policy enforcement, information campaigns, retail purchases, public observation/visits
Apply mandates to locations and enforce via Location.enforce_mask_policy with enforcement allocation
Schedule information campaigns and media broadcasts with reach/credibility; apply to agents
Retail dynamics: daily demand, rationing, price elasticity, restocking, subsidy, track supply_shortage_days
Decision rule: weighted components using provided weights, include observation noise and visibility

Metrics: adoption_rate, time_to_reach_threshold, peak and sustained adoption (last-14-day average), compliance under mandate, inequality across subgroups (income quintiles), price_effect_sensitivity (basic elasticity estimate), supply_shortage_days, churn_rate, campaign_reach
Align class names/fields with spec or add adapters (PublicHealthAuthority, MediaChannel, Person fields)
Parameter validation and error handling; remove unused imports
Implement main() to instantiate Simulation with parameters, run, and output metrics

task_understanding.adjustments: Strictly align implementation to the provided spec: ensure every named parameter and required interaction/metric is explicitly mapped and executed. Add a checklist-driven approach before coding.

data_analysis.adjustments: Limit scope to internal validation metrics for this iteration (e.g., sanity checks on adoption curves). Defer real-world data validation but scaffold hooks for future comparison.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan an MVP daily flow diagram covering all interactions and metrics. Prioritize minimal viable implementations for each required component over sophistication.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement the run loop and interactions first; then metrics. Add parameter mapping and adapters. Keep functions small and testable. Remove unused imports.

code_verification.adjustments: Run a short smoke test (e.g., time_steps=5) to ensure no runtime errors. Validate that all metrics are produced and non-null. Check edge cases on parameter bounds.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Provide a default parameter set and a reproducible seed. Ensure main() runs end-to-end and prints or returns the metrics JSON.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Add internal sanity checks: monotonicity where expected, reasonable adoption ranges, non-negative inventories. Compute and log key summary stats each day for debugging.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Focus feedback on remaining gaps after MVP: realism of decision model and external validation. Clearly report metric definitions and any assumptions.
